summary.text: Philip Houde is a Republican candidate for the New Hampshire House of Representatives, Strafford 12, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A lifelong Somersworth resident and machinist, Houde said in a Ballotpedia survey that he stands for fiscal responsibility and lower taxes.

paragraphs.text: Philip Houde graduated from Somersworth High School and earned an associate degree from Stratham Vocational Technical College in 1984.
Ballotpedia lists his career experience as machinist.
In a Ballotpedia survey, Houde said he was born, raised, educated and married in Somersworth and still lives there.
He listed keeping taxes stable, elderly care solutions, public school financing and new industry for solid jobs as priorities, and said he would audit state budgets for waste.
